title: 第123章 那半盒，还在家里
slug: 我一值夜班全院主任都睡不着
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

红区里，孩子还在吸氧。刚绑上腕带的中年男人捂着胸口，还在碎碎念：“我真就夹了一筷子。”

赵护士屁股刚沾椅子，又站了起来，语速比刚才快了一大截。

“平台电话别挂。”孙志强伸手接过听筒，“骑手、门岗、下单人，三边一起找。先问东西在谁手里，盒子开没开。”

马昊顺手按了免提。

电话那头先是平台客服，语速快得像打机关枪，听得出来怕担责任。

“订单显示已送达，骑手说放东苑小区北门保安亭了，收餐人电话一直占线。我们正在回拨骑手。”

孙志强没跟她扯流程。

“先别解释流程，把骑手接进来。”

几秒钟后，换了个年轻男人的声音，背景里有电动车刹车的刺耳声响。

“医生，我刚送完下一单。那份我记得，透明盒子，放保安亭窗台上了，备注确实写的给孩子留一半。我还拍照了。”

林野听见“窗台”两个字，眼神顿了顿。

窗台上人来人往。

那盒菜摆在那儿的时候，没人知道里面混的不是盐。

孙志强问：“照片能不能马上发平台，再转我们？”

“能，现在就发。”

电话里传来按手机的声音。

马昊盯着“外带”那栏，忍不住问：“孙老师，要不要直接叫120去小区？”

“先把人找准。”孙志强说，“别一车人空跑，盒子反倒已经进家门了。”

赵护士已经转头喊分诊护士。

“东苑小区，北门。先记地点。再给120指挥中心补一句，疑似同源外带，可能有孩子吃过。”

分诊护士应了一声，笔在本子上划得飞快。

林野在临时名单旁边补了四个字：东苑北门。

病名先不写，电话和门牌号都还没影。

平台很快接入门岗电话。

电话那头先传来一个带本地口音的男人声，听着有点不耐烦。

“喂？又怎么了？”

平台客服赶紧解释：“师傅，刚才有一份外卖放在东苑北门保安亭，可能有中毒风险，我们要确认一下东西还在不在。”

门岗那边顿了一下。

“外卖？北门一天放那么多份，你说哪一份？”

孙志强接得很快。

“透明盒，凉拌牛肉，备注给孩子留一半。刚才放窗台上的。”

门岗这回反应过来了。

“哦，那个啊，被个女的拿走了。穿睡衣，拖鞋，领着个小姑娘。”

马昊握着笔，“三栋”还是“五栋”，没敢往下写。

赵护士抬头接话。

“小姑娘多大？”

门岗更不耐烦了。

“这谁看得准？七八岁吧。背个粉色书包。小孩还问呢，妈妈，给我买肉了吗。”

孩子父亲坐在红区门口，听见“小姑娘”三个字，手里的手机差点掉地上。

“我家也是女儿。”他嗓子哑得厉害，“我妈还没接电话。”

赵护士没训他，只把手机往他手里推了推。

“接着打。打你妈，打邻居，打物业，能打谁打谁。”

孩子父亲点头，翻通讯录连着划错两次。

电话里，门岗还在说。

“她好像住三栋，还是五栋。我看她往里面走了。”

孙志强马上追问：“有没有业主群？物业电话？”

“有是有，你们这是干啥啊？一盒菜还能出多大事？”

门岗还在电话里嘀咕，红区那边忽然传来一声闷哼。

刚才还嘴硬的中年男人半撑着床沿，另一只手死死按在胸口，话都说不利索了。

心电图导联刚贴上，护士低头看了一眼监护仪。

“孙老师，这个心率一百二十六，嘴唇还是紫，指脉氧数值也不好看。”

孙志强回头扫了一眼，马上对着电话开口。

“那不是普通菜。你先别问能出多大事，先在群里发：凉拌牛肉别吃，已经吃了的，嘴唇发紫、胸闷、头晕、想吐，马上打120。就照这几句发，别自己改。”

门岗那边被他说得没声了。

过了两秒，才听见找笔的动静。

“你慢点，我记一下。”

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the red zone, the child is still receiving oxygen.The middle-aged man who had just put on the wristband was covering his chest and still muttering: "I just picked up a chopstick."

As soon as Nurse Zhao's butt touched the chair, she stood up again and spoke much faster than before.

"Don't hang up the phone on the platform." Sun Zhiqiang reached out and took the receiver. "The rider, the gatekeeper, and the person who placed the order will look for it together. First, ask who has the item and whether the box is open."

Ma Hao pressed the speaker phone smoothly.

On the other end of the phone was the platform customer service. He spoke as fast as a machine gun, and it sounded like he was afraid of taking responsibility.

"The order shows that it has been delivered. The rider said that the security booth at the north gate of Dongyuan Community was placed. The recipient's phone has been busy. We are calling the rider back."

Sun Zhiqiang didn't talk about the process with her.

"Don't explain the process yet, get the rider in."

A few seconds later, a young man's voice was heard, and in the background there was the harsh sound of electric vehicle brakes.

"Doctor, I just finished delivering the next order. I remember the transparent box, which was placed on the window sill of the security booth. The note was indeed written to leave half of it for the child. I also took pictures."

When Lin Ye heard the word "window sill", his eyes paused.

People were coming and going on the windowsill.

When the box of vegetables was placed there, no one knew that the salt was not mixed in it.

Sun Zhiqiang asked: "Can the photo be posted to the platform immediately and then forwarded to us?"

"Yes, send it now."

There was the sound of ringing the phone on the phone.

Ma Hao stared at the "Takeaway" column and couldn't help but ask: "Teacher Sun, do you want to call 120 directly to the community?"

“Find the right person first,” Sun Zhiqiang said. “Don’t leave a car full of people, because the box has already entered your home.”

Nurse Zhao has turned to call the triage nurse.

"Dongyuan Community, North Gate. Remember the location first. Then add a message to the 120 Command Center. It is suspected to be a takeaway from the same source. A child may have eaten it."

The triage nurse responded, writing quickly on the notebook.

Lin Ye added four words next to the temporary list: Dongyuan North Gate.

The name of the patient is not written down yet, but the phone number and house number are still missing.

The platform quickly accessed the door phone number.

A man's voice with a local accent came first from the other end of the phone, sounding a little impatient.

"Hello? What's wrong?"

The platform customer service quickly explained: "Master, there was a takeout just left at the security booth at the north gate of Dongyuan. There may be a risk of poisoning. We need to confirm whether the item is still there."

There was a pause at the gate post.

"Takeaway? Beimen puts out so many portions a day, which one do you want?"

Sun Zhiqiang picked up quickly.

"Transparent box, cold beef, note to leave half for the child. I just put it on the windowsill."

Mengang reacted this time.

"Oh, that one was taken away by a woman. Wearing pajamas and slippers, leading a little girl."

Ma Hao held the pen, "three buildings" or "five buildings", but did not dare to write down.

Nurse Zhao raised her head to answer.

"How old is the little girl?"

Mengang became even more impatient.

"Who can guess this accurately? He must be seven or eight years old. He carries a pink schoolbag. The kid even asked, Mom, did you buy me some meat?"

The child's father was sitting at the door of the red zone. When he heard the words "little girl," he almost dropped the phone in his hand.

"I am also a daughter." His voice was hoarse. "My mother hasn't answered the phone yet."

Nurse Zhao didn't scold him, she just pushed the phone into his hand.

"Keep on beating. Beat your mother, beat the neighbors, beat the property owner, beat whoever you can."

The child's father nodded, flipped through his address book and made two mistakes in a row.

On the phone, the gatekeeper was still talking.

"She seems to live in the third building, or the fifth one. I saw her walking inside."

Sun Zhiqiang immediately asked: "Is there a group of owners? What is the property phone number?"

"Yes, yes, what are you doing? How much trouble can a box of vegetables cause?"

Mengang was still muttering on the phone when a muffled groan suddenly came from the red zone.

The middle-aged man who had been so arrogant just now was half-supporting the edge of the bed and pressing his other hand firmly on his chest, making it difficult for him to speak clearly.

As soon as the ECG leads were attached, the nurse looked down at the monitor.

"Teacher Sun, the heart rate is 126, the lips are still purple, and the pulse oxygen value is not good."

Sun Zhiqiang glanced back and immediately spoke to the phone.

"That's not an ordinary dish. Don't ask how big a problem it will cause. First post it in the group: Don't eat the cold beef. If you have already eaten it and your lips are purple, your chest is tight, you feel dizzy or you feel like vomiting, call 120 immediately. Just post these sentences and don't change it yourself."

The person at the gate was silenced by his words.

After two seconds, I heard the sound of looking for a pen.

"Slow down, I'll take note of it."
